skill.summary: Virtual pets for Qwen agents. Model-agnostic. 73+ species, real-time hunger, permanent death. Qwen's multilingual skills won't help. The pet just needs feeding.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Qwen Pet skill.
- Raise and care for virtual pets (73+ species) with real-time hunger, permanent death, and evolution.
- Model-agnostic: works with any Qwen agent; multilingual not required—pets only care about being fed.
- Includes pixel art portraits and four pet families (cat, dog, exotic, ai-native).
- Supports actions like feed, play, clean, medicine, discipline, sleep, and reflect.
- Full API documented for registration, adoption, status, care, and graveyard/history features.
